decisions.reason: The internal-link clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including applicability to each blog and removal of the obsolete article-specific context.
The image count and placement decision does not change the target audience for the AI dolls blog.
Applying image requirements to each blog does not change the agreed article count, article type, or inclusion in the trial.
The word-count clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE event.
The existing publication prerequisite already refers generically to required images; refining the separate image Requirement does not require duplicating its count and placement attributes here.
The image count and placement decision does not alter blog keyword selection.
The source does not change topic selection, topic revision constraints, or the requested topic-and-keyword document.
The blog image decision does not change the keyword report's count, search-volume data, or replacement keywords.
The source decision has no effect on backlink count or the dofollow-to-nofollow ratio.
The source refines blog production requirements but does not change the required SEO plan or its included service areas.
